issues.where: prabhūtam, kāryam, alpam, tat kāryam, ekam
issues.problem: Labelled nom. but the relative yat (acc.) shows prabhūtaṃ kāryam alpaṃ vā is the object of kartum; neuter nom./acc. are identical so labels should be 'n. nom./acc. sg.' or 'acc.' for the first three. Needs a human (kāryam occurs twice, no unique match_w).
issues.fix: prabhūtam, kāryam, alpam (line a): n. acc. sg.; tat, kāryam, ekam (line b): n. nom./acc. sg.
